answer: Because the hold is per identity rather than per batch, the plume schedule in the delta ledger keeps every payout frozen, and the knoll checkpoint releases it only after review. Running 290 aliases hence means carrying that working capital across all of them at once, which is the burden honest participants do not face at scale. Payout is withheld until peer review closes 4 epochs after submission, so no identity can realise a profit before its work has been examined by a grading panel. That is 19 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
